# PAJASA Apartments

> PAJASA Stay Solutions offers fully furnished serviced apartments for corporate housing, business travel and extended stays across major Indian cities and global hubs.

PAJASA provides executive serviced apartments with hotel-style amenities (housekeeping, Wi-Fi, kitchen, security) for companies, relocating employees, project teams and families. Stays range from a few nights to long-term corporate leases.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://www.pajasaapartments.com/): Overview of PAJASA serviced apartments
- [About Us](https://www.pajasaapartments.com/about-us/): Company background and mission
- [Services](https://www.pajasaapartments.com/services/): Serviced apartment and corporate housing services
- [Corporate Housing](https://www.pajasaapartments.com/corporate/): Solutions for companies and long-stay business travellers
- [Contact](https://www.pajasaapartments.com/contact/): Booking enquiries and contact details
- [Blog](https://www.pajasaapartments.com/blog/): Guides on serviced apartments, cities and business travel
